items.title: Jack Kelly Interview, 1963-11-17
items.q: the most amazing day I've lived with a fella called King Kulak

ctx.x: He got the way he wanted. Who do you think sounds like him today? Have you heard many people?

Well, that one of the men ever came here, I think, the most amazing day I've lived with a fella called King Kulak. I don't think y'all know him. He's from Chicago? I think so. I heard of him. And that big man is powerful as no man was. Uh-huh. And he used to come here during the war, and that's been the whole power he needed. And he's great. And he's no way in the books, he's done having no ragged around, nothing. But that's the only way he's come close to those men. Right there, it's pretty cold, I could blow…
I've never heard a record of him.
